index.title: Components
index.subtitle: UI component documentation that follows Figma WDS: properties, states, tokens, and behavior.

playground.title: Playground
playground.hint: Change props with the controls; the preview and code update together.

figma.title: Figma properties → props
figma.hint: How the Figma WDS component properties and variable modes map to this component's props.

states.title: States
states.hint: States are forced with {{attr}} for documentation only; in the app, states come from interaction (hover, press, keyboard focus, disabled).

tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.hint: Source: {{file}}. Values are live for the active theme.

table.summary: WDS table with white or gray header, sortable columns, row hover / selected / loading states, an action column and built-in empty and error views.

styles.note: White or gray header background.

rowStates.note: Hover is a subtle fill; highlighted rows use the selected fill; loading shows skeleton rows.

header.note: Click a sortable header to sort.

cell.note: Cell padding follows the Size tokens; dense tightens the vertical padding.

props.columns: Column definitions, row data and a stable row key.
props.paging: Pagination state (the Pagination component renders below).
props.showRowNumber: Adds a page-aware row number column.
props.renderAction: Action column content and its side.
props.state: Loading skeleton, error view, empty view.
props.sticky: Keep the header / action column in view while scrolling.

behavior: Long cell text is truncated with a tooltip when fixed layout is used.
Sticky cells keep an opaque background so scrolled content does not show through.
The table scrolls horizontally inside its frame.
accessibility: Uses native table markup with header cells.
Sortable headers are clickable; keep column names meaningful.

tabs.summary: WDS tabs in four styles: default, box, underline and segmented. Supports icons, a count badge, disabled tabs, arrow-key navigation and a full-width mode.

styles.note: Default has no indicator; box fills the current tab; underline adds a brand line; segmented sits in a filled track.

states.note: The current tab is the one matching `value`.

item.note: Each item takes an optional icon and a badge.

props.value: Selected tab value and change handler.
props.fullWidth: Tabs share the container width equally.
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding, gap, text).

behavior: Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs and select them; disabled tabs are skipped.
Only the selected tab is in the tab order.
Panels are rendered by the caller.
accessibility: Uses role="tablist" / "tab" with aria-selected.
Give the tablist an aria-label.

button.summary: WDS action button. Hierarchy sets visual emphasis (primary → text), the destructive style is for dangerous actions, and states (hover, pressed, focus, disabled) and sizes come from design tokens.

destructive.note: Red style for any hierarchy; variant="danger" turns it on automatically.

hierarchy.note: Legacy shortcut: variant primary/secondary/danger maps to a hierarchy (+ destructive).

size.note: md = 44px high, padding 12/16, radius 8.

shape.note: box uses the size radius token; rounded is a pill.

icons.note: both = leading + trailing; only = iconOnly (padding.all, minimum width 44).

states.note: :hover, :active, :focus-visible, :disabled; no props.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchy
hierarchy.description: One primary action per area; the rest secondary or lower.

destructive.title: Destructive
destructive.description: For actions that delete data or cannot be undone.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: The Figma “Show icons” modes: leading, trailing, both, and only.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding, radius, font, icon).
props.iconOnly: Icon only (children are ignored). Always set aria-label.
props.variant: Legacy shortcut. danger = primary + destructive; custom = no WDS colors (colors come from className).
props.iconLegacy: Legacy shortcut for a single icon.
props.rest: onClick, type, aria-*, etc. are passed to the <button>.

tokens.--wds-text-on-brand: Text color on top of brand.

behavior: Hover, pressed, focus, and disabled come from the WDS state tokens (Button states): :hover, :active, :focus-visible, :disabled.
The focus ring only appears for keyboard focus (:focus-visible): a 1px stroke outside the button with a 2px gap.
Disabled: not-allowed cursor, cannot be focused or clicked, colors from the disabled tokens.
Minimum width follows the Size token (44px at md); width hugs the content.
The label uses Inter Medium (500), matching the Figma node.
`type` is not set automatically: inside a <form> the button is a submit button. Use type="button" for regular actions.
The brand color follows the primary color chosen in Settings (hover/pressed are derived).
accessibility: Icon-only buttons (iconOnly) must have an aria-label.
Use the real <button> element so Enter and Space work natively.
The focus ring stays visible in every hierarchy; do not remove the outline through className.
Make sure label contrast follows the tokens (on-brand text over the brand background).

do: One primary button per area/main action.
Use clear verb labels (Save, Delete).
Use destructive for actions that delete data.
dont: Do not place several primary buttons side by side.
Do not use variant="custom" to imitate an existing hierarchy.
Do not put long text in a button; it is not designed for multiple lines.

checkbox.summary: WDS checkbox for independent options. Two styles (outline, solid), five sizes, a mixed state, a hint line, and error / disabled / focus states from the design tokens.

supporting.note: Shown under the label; the error message takes its place.

style.note: Outline: blue border and mark, no fill. Solid: filled with the info color and a white mark.

states.note: Derived from props and interaction; focus is orthogonal (a ring around the control).

types.note: Icon only = no label (omit the label prop).

modes.note: Hint mode lowers the control 2px to align with the label line.

tick.note: Equals the value prop; no extra prop.

horizontal.note: The Horizontal variant is a row of options: `CheckboxGroup`.

appearance.title: Style
appearance.description: Outline has a blue border and mark; Solid is filled.

props.label: Label next to the control; omit it for an icon-only control.
props.hint: Supporting text under the label (replaced by the error message).
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (box, gap, text).
props.indeterminate: Mixed state (dash) — takes precedence over checked.
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot.

tokens.--wds-bg-info: Fill of the solid style (and toggle track) when selected.
tokens.--wds-icons-on-brand: Mark color on solid fill (check, dot, thumb).

behavior: Click the box or the label to toggle; Space toggles when focused.
`indeterminate` shows a dash and takes precedence over `checked` (e.g. “select all” with partial selection).
Disabled keeps the selected/unselected look at 40% opacity (disabled-on / disabled-off).
The error state applies to unselected boxes; a selected box keeps its fill and only the border turns red.
The error message replaces the hint under the label and uses the danger color.
Sizes follow the Size tokens (16–32px); the focus ring is a 1px stroke 2px outside, shown for keyboard focus only.
accessibility: Use a real label (the label prop) so the control has an accessible name; icon-only controls need aria-label on the wrapper context.
Keep the native input: it provides keyboard, focus, and form semantics (the visible box is decorative).
Errors are announced via role="alert" in the hint slot; invalid controls set aria-invalid.
Do not rely on color alone: the mark (check, dot, thumb position) also shows the state.

do: Use a checkbox for independent yes/no options and multi-select lists.
Use radio for one choice among a few options.
Use a toggle for settings that apply immediately.
dont: Do not use a checkbox/radio where a toggle’s immediate effect is expected.
Do not use a toggle in forms that need a Save step.
Do not use long label text; keep it to one or two lines.

group.summary: CheckboxGroup renders a set of checkboxes from an `options` list (value is an array). Options flow horizontally and wrap, spaced by the form-row options gap (16px). One error message is shown under the whole group.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Each option can have a hint under its label.

error.title: Error
error.description: The message appears once under the group; every control shows the error state.

props.options: List of options; `hint` and `disabled` are optional per option.
props.appearance: Figma Style for every control: outline or solid.
props.error: Error message for the group; every control shows the error state.
props.testId: Mapped to data-testid; each option gets `<testId>-<value>`.
props.direction: Layout of the options: horizontal (wraps) or vertical.

toggle.summary: WDS toggle for settings that take effect immediately. Five sizes, a dynamic or static label, a hint line, and error / disabled / focus states from the design tokens.

supporting.note: Shown under the label; the error message takes its place.

style.note: Outline: blue border and mark, no fill. Solid: filled with the info color and a white mark.

states.note: Derived from props and interaction; focus is orthogonal (a ring around the control).

types.note: Icon only = no label (omit the label prop).

modes.note: Hint mode lowers the control 2px to align with the label line.

tick.note: Equals the value prop; no extra prop.

props.label: Label: `switchLabel` (static) or `checkedLabel` / `uncheckedLabel` (follow the value).
props.hint: Supporting text under the label (replaced by the error message).
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (box, gap, text).
props.indeterminate: Mixed state (dash) — takes precedence over checked.
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot.

tokens.--wds-bg-info: Fill of the solid style (and toggle track) when selected.
tokens.--wds-icons-on-brand: Mark color on solid fill (check, dot, thumb).

behavior: Click the track or the label to switch; Space toggles when focused (role="switch").
Track is 1.8× the height and the thumb 0.8× (Figma 43.2×24 and 19.2px at md).
`checkedLabel` / `uncheckedLabel` swap the label with the value; `switchLabel` is a static label.
Disabled keeps the on/off look at 40% opacity. Figma leaves the off-state fill empty, so the unselected track fill is kept to keep the thumb visible.
The error message replaces the hint under the label and uses the danger color.
The focus ring is a 1px stroke 2px outside, shown for keyboard focus only.
accessibility: Use a real label (the label prop) so the control has an accessible name; icon-only controls need aria-label on the wrapper context.
Keep the native input: it provides keyboard, focus, and form semantics (the visible box is decorative).
Errors are announced via role="alert" in the hint slot; invalid controls set aria-invalid.
Do not rely on color alone: the mark (check, dot, thumb position) also shows the state.

do: Use a checkbox for independent yes/no options and multi-select lists.
Use radio for one choice among a few options.
Use a toggle for settings that apply immediately.
dont: Do not use a checkbox/radio where a toggle’s immediate effect is expected.
Do not use a toggle in forms that need a Save step.
Do not use long label text; keep it to one or two lines.

radio-button.summary: WDS radio for a single choice. Two styles (outline, solid), five sizes, a hint line, and error / disabled / focus states from the design tokens.

supporting.note: Shown under the label; the error message takes its place.

style.note: Outline: blue border and mark, no fill. Solid: filled with the info color and a white mark.

states.note: Derived from props and interaction; focus is orthogonal (a ring around the control).

types.note: Icon only = no label (omit the label prop).

modes.note: Hint mode lowers the control 2px to align with the label line.

tick.note: Equals the value prop; no extra prop.

horizontal.note: The Horizontal variant is a row of options: `RadioButtonGroup`.

appearance.title: Style
appearance.description: Outline has a blue border and mark; Solid is filled.

props.label: Label next to the control; omit it for an icon-only control.
props.hint: Supporting text under the label (replaced by the error message).
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (box, gap, text).
props.indeterminate: Mixed state (dash) — takes precedence over checked.
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot.

tokens.--wds-bg-info: Fill of the solid style (and toggle track) when selected.
tokens.--wds-icons-on-brand: Mark color on solid fill (check, dot, thumb).

behavior: Clicking the control or the label selects the option; arrow keys move within a native radio group.
A radio cannot be unselected by clicking it again.
Use RadioButtonGroup for sets of options: one shared error message under the group.
Outline shows a 12px colored dot; Solid shows a filled circle with an 8px white dot.
Disabled keeps the selected/unselected look at 40% opacity.
The focus ring is a 1px stroke 2px outside, shown for keyboard focus only.
accessibility: Use a real label (the label prop) so the control has an accessible name; icon-only controls need aria-label on the wrapper context.
Keep the native input: it provides keyboard, focus, and form semantics (the visible box is decorative).
Errors are announced via role="alert" in the hint slot; invalid controls set aria-invalid.
Do not rely on color alone: the mark (check, dot, thumb position) also shows the state.

do: Use a checkbox for independent yes/no options and multi-select lists.
Use radio for one choice among a few options.
Use a toggle for settings that apply immediately.
dont: Do not use a checkbox/radio where a toggle’s immediate effect is expected.
Do not use a toggle in forms that need a Save step.
Do not use long label text; keep it to one or two lines.

group.summary: RadioButtonGroup renders a set of radio buttons from an `options` list (value is the chosen option). Options flow horizontally and wrap, spaced by the form-row options gap (16px). One error message is shown under the whole group.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Each option can have a hint under its label.

error.title: Error
error.description: The message appears once under the group; every control shows the error state.

props.options: List of options; `hint` and `disabled` are optional per option.
props.appearance: Figma Style for every control: outline or solid.
props.error: Error message for the group; every control shows the error state.
props.testId: Mapped to data-testid; each option gets `<testId>-<value>`.
props.direction: Layout of the options: horizontal (wraps) or vertical.

input-field.summary: WDS text input. Two styles (box, underline), five sizes, leading/trailing icons, dropdown segments, a help icon, a hint line, and default / focus / typing / filled / disabled / error / read-only states from the design tokens. Label and description come from FormItem.

label.note: The label is rendered by FormItem (label, required mark, help tooltip).

description.note: Rendered by FormItem under the label.

hint.note: Shown under the field; the error message replaces it.

layout.note: FormItem layout="horizontal" puts the label on the left (gap 40).

states.note: Derived from interaction and props: focus (selected / typing), value (filled), disabled, readOnly, error.

size.note: Height from padding + line height (44px at md); text 12/14/14/16/16.

help.note: Question-circle icon at the field end with a tooltip.

type.note: Leading/Trailing dropdown = a tinted segment with its own padding and a divider.

icons.note: 20px icons inside the field (color from the icon tokens).

styles.note: box: full border and radius 8. underline: bottom border only, no radius or fill.

appearance.title: Style
appearance.description: Box has a full border; underline only a bottom line.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding, text, gap).
props.hint: Supporting text under the field (replaced by the error message).
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot (danger color).
props.sanitize: Cleans the value on every change.
props.appearance: Figma Input styles: box (default) or underline.
props.help: Help icon at the end of the field; the content shows as a tooltip.
props.prepend: Leading / trailing icon or content inside the field.
props.group: Type “Leading / Trailing dropdown”: a tinted segment (e.g. country code, unit).
props.clearable: Shows a clear button while there is text.
props.currency: Formats digits as currency (id-ID); onChange receives the raw digits.
props.rest: type, name, maxLength, aria-*, etc. are passed to the <input>.

behavior: Focus (mouse or keyboard) turns the border to the focus color; an empty focused field is “selected”, a focused field with text is “typing”.
The focus ring (1px stroke, 2px gap) appears for keyboard focus only.
Disabled and read-only use the disabled background; disabled blocks focus, read-only still allows selecting text.
Error shows a red border and error icon, and the message replaces the hint under the field.
`clearable` shows a clear button while there is text; `currency` formats digits and returns the raw digits.
Non-ASCII characters are stripped on input (existing behavior), then `sanitize` runs.
accessibility: Always provide a label (FormItem label) or aria-label; the placeholder is not a label.
Errors use role="alert" and the input gets aria-invalid.
The clear button is outside the tab order on purpose; Escape/Delete keep working in the input.
Keep the focus ring visible; do not remove the outline through className.

do: Use a clear, short placeholder as an example, not as the label.
Show validation messages next to the field.
Pick the dropdown segment for units or country codes.
dont: Do not use the placeholder as the only label.
Do not hide errors in tooltips.
Do not mix underline and box styles in one form.

textarea.summary: WDS multi-line input. Five sizes, a hint line with an optional n/max counter, auto-grow, and default / focus / typing / filled / disabled / error / read-only states from the design tokens.

label.note: The label is rendered by FormItem (label, required mark, help tooltip).

description.note: Rendered by FormItem under the label.

hint.note: Shown under the field; the error message replaces it.

layout.note: FormItem layout="horizontal" puts the label on the left (gap 40).

states.note: Derived from interaction and props: focus (selected / typing), value (filled), disabled, readOnly, error.

size.note: Height from padding + line height (44px at md); text 12/14/14/16/16.

dynamic.note: autoGrow: height follows the content and the resize handle is removed.

counter.note: Setting maxLength shows the n/max counter on the right of the hint row.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding, text, gap).
props.hint: Supporting text under the field (replaced by the error message).
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot (danger color).
props.sanitize: Cleans the value on every change.
props.maxLength: Limit; also shows the n/max counter in the hint row.
props.autoGrow: Height follows the content (Figma “Dynamic?”); no resize handle.
props.rest: name, maxLength, aria-*, etc. are passed to the <textarea>.

behavior: Minimum height is 128px; by default it can be resized vertically.
`autoGrow` makes the height follow the content and removes the resize handle.
`maxLength` shows an n/max counter at the right of the hint row.
Focus, filled, disabled, read-only, and error states follow the Textarea state tokens; the focus ring is for keyboard focus only.
Error shows a red border and the message replaces the hint.
accessibility: Always provide a label (FormItem label) or aria-label.
Errors use role="alert" and the textarea gets aria-invalid.
Keep the focus ring visible.

do: Set maxLength when there is a real limit.
Use autoGrow for short notes.
dont: Do not use a textarea for single-line values.
Do not rely on the counter alone to explain the limit.

select.summary: WDS select. Single mode and a `multiple` prop (tags), box and underline styles, five sizes, search, async options with paging, a hint line, and default / open / filled / disabled / error / read-only states from the design tokens. The dropdown uses the WDS menu.

label.note: The label is rendered by FormItem.

description.note: Rendered by FormItem under the label.

hint.note: Shown under the field; the error message replaces it.

layout.note: FormItem layout="horizontal" puts the label on the left (gap 40).

styles.note: box: full border and radius 8. underline: bottom border only, no radius or fill.

states.note: Derived from props and interaction: open (selected), value (filled), disabled, readOnly, error.

size.note: Same box as Input Field: 44px at md; sizes 36/40/44/48/52.

modes.note: single = default; multiple = the `multiple` prop (tags, clear button, divider).

menu.note: Panel: padding 8, radius 12, gap 4; items 44px, radius 8. Highlight = pressed, chosen = selected.

icons.note: Figma icon configuration: leading, trailing or both.

props.appearance: Figma Select styles: box (default) or underline.
props.hint: Supporting text (replaced by the error message).
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot.
props.searchable: Type in the field to filter (or search via loadOptions).
props.clearable: Shows a clear button while there is a value.
props.loadOptions: Async options; paginateOnScroll loads the next page on scroll.
props.optionDisabled: Options that return true are shown disabled.
props.multipleProps: Multiple mode: the value becomes an array of values and selected options show as tags.
props.icons: Icon shown at the start of the field and before the chevron.

tokens.--wds-bg-brand-subtle: Selected menu item / hover / range days.

behavior: Click (or focus, when searchable) opens the menu; the border turns to the focus color and the arrow flips up (state “selected”).
Menu items: highlighted (mouse or arrow keys) = pressed, chosen = selected (check mark), disabled = muted.
Arrow keys move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape closes (searchable).
Multiple mode shows tags with a remove button, a clear button and a divider before the arrow; options show a checkbox unless hideCheckBox.
The menu is rendered in a portal and follows the field width; long lists scroll (max 240px).
Error shows a red border and the message replaces the hint.
accessibility: Provide a label (FormItem label) or aria-label.
The trigger exposes aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded; options use role="option" with aria-selected.
Errors use role="alert".

do: Use Select for 5+ options; use radio for fewer.
Enable search for long lists.
dont: Do not use Select for actions.
Do not nest menus.

date-picker.summary: WDS date field with a calendar popup. Single date, a `range` prop for date ranges, optional time, box and underline styles, five sizes, a hint line, and default / open / filled / disabled / error / read-only states from the design tokens.

label.note: The label is rendered by FormItem.

description.note: Rendered by FormItem under the label.

hint.note: Shown under the field; the error message replaces it.

layout.note: FormItem layout="horizontal" puts the label on the left (gap 40).

styles.note: box: full border and radius 8. underline: bottom border only, no radius or fill.

states.note: Derived from props and interaction: open (selected), value (filled), disabled, readOnly, error.

size.note: Same box as Input Field: 44px at md; sizes 36/40/44/48/52.

calendar.note: Selected day = brand circle; today = focus-colored ring; in-range days = brand subtle.

rangeMode.note: The `range` prop switches to a date range.

range.title: Date range
range.description: Pick a start and an end date.

props.onChange: Called with the new ISO text.
props.appearance: Figma Date Picker styles: box (default) or underline.
props.clearable: Shows a clear button while there is a value.
props.hint: Supporting text (replaced by the error message).
props.error: Error message: error state + text in the hint slot.
props.range: Range mode: value becomes “start,end”; the first click sets the start, the second the end.

tokens.--wds-bg-brand-subtle: Selected menu item / hover / range days.

behavior: Clicking the field opens the calendar; the border turns to the focus color (state “selected”). Read-only and disabled fields do not open it.
Picking a day applies it immediately and closes the calendar (with showTime it stays open to set the time). Escape or clicking outside closes without changing the value.
The header switches between days, months, and years; arrows move the page.
Calendar: radius 12, padding 16, 40px day cells; selected day is a brand circle, today a focus-colored ring.
Date range: the first click sets the start, the second sets the end, applies the range, and closes the calendar; days in between are highlighted.
Error shows a red border and the message replaces the hint.
accessibility: Provide a label (FormItem label) or aria-label.
The field is read-only text; the calendar is the input method, so also show the expected format in the hint.
Errors use role="alert".

do: Limit selectable dates with minDate / maxDate.
Use range for periods.
dont: Do not use a date picker for birthdays far in the past without year navigation.
Do not hide the expected format.

badge.summary: WDS badge for status, counts and tags. Six styles, five sizes, and types: dot, counter, leading / trailing icon, close button and icon only.

styles.note: Each style maps to a subtle background with a matching text and icon color.

types.note: Combine freely; icon only hides the label and needs an aria-label.

size.note: Pill shape; height and text size follow the Size tokens.

types.title: Types
types.description: Dot, counter, icons, close and icon only.

props.legacy: Still accepted and mapped to the closest style (error → danger).
props.dot: Shows a status dot before the label.
props.onRemove: Shows a close button and calls this on click.

behavior: Static element; it is not focusable unless it has a close button.
The close button calls onRemove and is a real button with its own focus ring.
The counter is shown as a small inverse bubble after the label.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone; keep a meaningful label.
Icon only and dot-only badges need an aria-label.
The close button has an accessible name.

alert.summary: WDS alert for inline messages. Four styles in four appearances, optional title, action and close button.

styles.note: Info, success, warning and danger set colors and icon.

variant.note: Basic: plain with border. Solid: filled. Light: subtle fill. Left stroke: accent bar.

types.note: Action renders a text button; onClose renders a close icon.

props.title: Optional title above the message.
props.action: Text button with label and click handler.

behavior: Danger and warning use role="alert"; others use role="status".
The close button calls onClose; hiding is up to the parent.
Basic uses outline icons; other appearances use filled icons.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone; the icon and text carry the meaning.
The close button has an accessible name.
Keep messages short and actionable.

tooltip.summary: WDS tooltip for short hints. Four placements, optional leading icon, shown on hover, focus or click.

position.note: Preferred side; clamped to the viewport.

styles.note: Brand background with on-brand text.

behavior: Opens on hover, focus and click of the trigger; Escape closes it.
Rendered in a portal and positioned next to the trigger, clamped to the viewport.
Hugs its content up to maxWidth.
accessibility: The trigger is described by the tooltip (aria-describedby).
Do not put essential information only in a tooltip.
Keyboard focus shows the tooltip too.

dialog.summary: WDS dialog for confirmations and short tasks. Title, supporting text, optional featured icon, content and a footer for actions.

styles.note: Icon style shows a featured icon above the title.

types.note: Alert has one button; confirm has a secondary and a primary button — pass them in footer.

size.note: Spacing follows the Size tokens.

props.open: Controlled visibility and the close handler.
props.title: Dialog title.
props.footer: Action buttons, aligned to the right.
props.close: Hide or disable the close button.

tokens.--wds-sz-dialog-text-gap: Gap between title and supporting text.

behavior: Rendered in a portal over a dimmed backdrop; page scroll is locked while open.
Escape and a backdrop click close it unless disabled.
The panel fades and scales in.
accessibility: The panel has role="dialog" and aria-modal.
The close button has an accessible name.
Keep one primary action in the footer.

drawer.summary: WDS drawer: a side panel with title, scrollable content and a footer. Modal with a backdrop, or non-modal so the page stays interactive.

styles.note: Elevated background with primary title and icons.

gap.note: Section gap grows with the Size mode.

props.open: Controlled visibility and the close handler.
props.title: Drawer title.
props.modal: Backdrop and scroll lock; false keeps the page interactive.

behavior: Slides in from the right and out again before unmounting.
Non-modal: a click outside closes it, except in dialogs and select menus.
Escape closes it; a non-modal drawer ignores Escape while a dialog is open.
accessibility: The close button has an accessible name.
Modal drawers lock page scroll.
Keep the footer actions consistent with dialogs.

pagination.summary: WDS pagination with a 7-slot page window, previous / next, optional first / last and labels, and a rows-per-page selector. Square or round buttons.

styles.note: Square uses an 8px radius; round is a pill. The current page is brand-filled.

labels.note: Adds Previous / Next text to the navigation buttons.

props.page: Current page (1-based) and total number of pages.
props.pageSize: Rows per page and its change handler (needed to show the selector).

behavior: Shows up to 7 slots: the start, middle and end windows use ellipses.
Previous / first are disabled on page 1; next / last on the last page.
Disabled buttons use 40% opacity.
accessibility: The nav landmark is labelled "Pagination"; the current page has aria-current="page".
Icon-only buttons have an accessible name.

table-toolbar.summary: WDS table toolbar: a search field and a filter button that opens a filter drawer. The button turns tonal while filters are active.

states.note: Filtered = at least one value differs from its default; the filter button becomes tonal.

search.note: Debounced; synced to the URL when searchParamName is set.

filter.note: Fields are rendered in a side drawer with Reset and Apply.

buttons.note: `actions` adds buttons next to Filter; `leading` replaces the left side for the Calendar type. A Reset Filter text button appears while filters are active.

props.search: Controlled search text and change handler.
props.filterValues: Applied values and the defaults that do not count as active.
props.filterTitle: Title of the button and drawer.
props.withFilterButton: Hide the filter button when false.
props.debounce: Search debounce and URL param name.
props.actions: Extra buttons on the right (e.g. Export) and content before the search (e.g. a segmented control).

behavior: Typing updates the search after the debounce delay.
Apply closes the drawer and resets to page 1; Reset clears the values.
The drawer uses the same panel as Drawer.
accessibility: The drawer has role="dialog" with the filter title as its label.
The close button has an accessible name.

card.summary: WDS card container with a title, actions, body and optional footer. Outlined or filled, collapsible, and a compact size for narrow panels.

styles.note: Outlined has a subtle border on the surface color; filled uses a subtle background and no border.

title.note: Header text; the header shows a divider while the body is open.

actions.note: `actions` sits in the header, `footer` is a divider-topped action row.

media.note: Image or media above the body.

props.title: Header title and header actions.
props.size: `sm` is a compact variant for narrow panels.
props.collapsible: Click the header to collapse; `defaultOpen` and a custom toggle icon.
props.media: Card media, supporting text under the title, and equal-width action buttons (WDS card layout).

behavior: Collapsible cards hide the body and footer; the header divider hides with them.
The header becomes a real button when collapsible.
accessibility: The collapsible header exposes aria-expanded.
Use a descriptive title.

empty-state.summary: WDS empty state: illustration, title, supporting text and actions, centered.

supporting.note: Explains what happened or what to do.

illustration.note: An icon or image placed in a rounded placeholder.

props.title: Main message.
props.illustration: Icon or image above the title.

behavior: Content is centered and hugs its width.
Use inside a Card or Table body when there is no data.
accessibility: Keep the title short and specific.
Provide a next step in the actions when possible.

file-upload.summary: WDS file upload: a drop area with a featured icon, supporting text, a simulated progress bar and file cards for the selected files.

states.note: Hover (also while dragging) uses the brand tint; error and disabled follow the field states.

cards.note: Selected files are listed as cards with view and remove actions.

props.value: Selected file(s) and the change handler.
props.hint: Supporting text, e.g. allowed format and size.
props.error: Error message; turns the area red.

behavior: Click, Enter / Space or drop to pick files.
Upload progress is simulated on the client (no real upload).
New files are ignored while an upload is in progress.
accessibility: The area is a focusable button (role="button").
The error message uses role="alert".

avatar.summary: WDS avatar with initials, an icon or an image, in default (circle) or rounded style and an optional online indicator.

styles.note: Default is a rounded square (radius follows the Size tokens); rounded is a circle.

online.note: Green dot with an inverse ring at the bottom right.

props.name: Name for the initial.
props.src: Image URL or an icon replacing the initial.

behavior: Shows the first letter of the name when there is no image or icon.
accessibility: Images use the name as alt text.

page-header.summary: WDS page header: title, breadcrumb, actions and a right slot for the profile menu. Shows a menu button on small screens.

breadcrumb.note: Links use the link color; the last item is plain text.

props.title: Page title.
props.actions: Right-side nodes, e.g. buttons or Profile.

behavior: The title truncates when space runs out.
Horizontal padding shrinks below 1024px.
accessibility: The breadcrumb is a nav landmark labelled "Breadcrumb".
The menu button has an accessible name.

profile.summary: WDS profile trigger with avatar, name and role, opening a menu with language, settings and logout.

states.note: Hover and the open state use the brand subtle fill; the chevron flips when open.

user.note: Greeting uses the first name with the role underneath; add the avatar with showAvatar.

avatar.note: The avatar is an optional instance in Figma and hidden by default; turn it on with showAvatar.

props.settings: Settings link path and label overrides.
props.showAvatar: Shows the avatar before the name (hidden by default, as in Figma).

behavior: Clicking outside closes the menu.
The menu opens upward when there is little room below.
accessibility: The trigger exposes aria-expanded.

side-navbar.summary: WDS side navbar on the brand-pressed background: logo, nav items with expandable groups, collapsible to an icon rail, and a drawer on mobile.

styles.note: Brand-pressed background; nav items use the dark style.

navItem.note: Hover and the current route use the brand fill; keyboard focus shows an outline.

logo.note: Pass a node or let it show the app name.

props.collapsed: Icon rail mode and its toggle handler.
props.mobile: Mobile drawer visibility and close handler.
props.logo: Logo node or app name text.

behavior: Groups expand on click and stay open while a child route is active.
Collapsed: hovering an item opens a flyout with its children.
On mobile the bar slides in over a backdrop.
accessibility: Group buttons expose aria-expanded.
The active route has aria-current="page".

breadcrumbs.summary: WDS breadcrumbs: links separated by chevrons; the last item is the current page.

states.note: Hover and the current item use the brand color; pressed is darker; disabled is muted.

truncated.note: Keeps the first item and the last ones, with "…" in between.

props.items: Trail items; the last one is current.
props.maxItems: Collapses the middle of a long trail into an ellipsis once it exceeds this number.

behavior: Items without `to` render as plain text.
The trail wraps on narrow screens.
accessibility: A nav landmark labelled "Breadcrumb" with an ordered list.
The last item has aria-current="page".

link.summary: WDS text link with optional underline and leading / trailing icons.

styles.note: Underline is always visible in the underline style.

states.note: Hover and pressed share the pressed color; focus shows a ring.

behavior: Renders a native anchor; wrap router links around it when needed.
Disabled links cancel navigation and leave the tab order.
accessibility: Disabled links expose aria-disabled.
Use descriptive text instead of "click here".

divider.summary: WDS divider in three strengths, horizontal or vertical.

styles.note: Subtle, default and strong map to the stroke colors.

behavior: A vertical divider stretches to the height of its flex container.
accessibility: Uses role="separator" with aria-orientation.

accordion.summary: WDS accordion with box or underline style, supporting text, disabled items and single or multiple expansion.

styles.note: Box has a bordered card per item; underline separates items with a line.

states.note: Hover and pressed tint the header; disabled mutes it; focus shows a ring.

supporting.note: Shown under the title in the header.

flip.note: Chevron before the title instead of after.

size.note: Padding and text follow the Size tokens.

props.items: Sections: value, title, optional description, content.
props.size: Size from the Size tokens; `flipIcon` moves the chevron to the start.

behavior: The chevron rotates when open.
Without `multiple`, opening one item closes the others.
accessibility: Headers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Open panels use role="region".

progress.summary: WDS linear progress indicator in default, success and danger styles with an optional percent label.

styles.note: The indicator and label color follow the style.

label.note: Percent label at the end of the track.

mode.note: Determinate shows the value; indeterminate animates.

size.note: Track height follows the Size tokens.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (track height).

behavior: The value is clamped to 0–100.
The bar animates width changes.
accessibility: Uses role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow.
Provide an aria-label.

banner.summary: WDS banner: a full-width message with icon, optional title, action and close button in five styles.

styles.note: Info, success, warning and danger use subtle fills; default is white with a border.

actions.note: Rendered as small Buttons: `action` primary, `secondaryAction` secondary.

size.note: Padding and icon size follow the Size tokens.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding, icon, text).

behavior: Spans the full width of its container, without rounded corners.
Hiding after close is up to the parent.
accessibility: Danger and warning use role="alert"; others role="status".
The close button has an accessible name.

search-bar.summary: WDS search bar with box or pill style, a leading icon, a clear button and a disabled state.

styles.note: Box uses a white fill and default border; pill is rounded on a subtle fill.

states.note: Focus changes the border color; typing shows the clear button.

clear.note: Resets the value and returns focus to the input.

voice.note: Microphone icon at the end of the bar.

size.note: Height and icon size follow the Size tokens (md = 44px).

props.clearable: Show the clear button when there is text.
props.size: Size from the Size tokens; `voice` shows a microphone icon at the end.

behavior: The native clear button of search inputs is hidden in favor of the WDS one.
accessibility: The input is type="search".
The clear button has an accessible name.

stepper.summary: WDS stepper with upcoming, current, completed and error steps, in horizontal or vertical layout.

states.note: States follow `current`; set `status` on a step to force one (e.g. error).

text.note: Optional small label above the title, plus supporting text.

badge.note: Status pill under the text (e.g. Success / In Progress / Pending).

size.note: Sizes follow the Size tokens.

props.steps: Steps with title, optional label (e.g. "Step 1"), description, status badge and status.
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (indicator, gaps, text).

behavior: Steps before `current` are completed and show a check.
The connector takes the color of the step before it.
accessibility: An ordered list; the current step has aria-current="step".

slider.summary: WDS slider built on a native range input with a brand track and a ringed thumb.

states.note: Pressed uses the pressed brand fill and focus stroke; disabled mutes everything.

range.note: Single thumb, or two thumbs with `range`.

size.note: Track and thumb scale with the Size tokens.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (track and thumb).
props.rangeProp: Two thumbs; `value` becomes a [min, max] pair.

behavior: Keyboard: arrows, Home, End, Page Up / Down (native).
The filled part follows the value.
accessibility: Native range input; give it an aria-label.

rating.summary: WDS star rating, read-only or interactive.

styles.note: Filled stars use the warning icon color; empty ones the disabled color.

size.note: Star size follows the Size tokens.

props.onChange: Makes it interactive; clicking the current star clears it.
props.size: Size from the Size tokens (star size).

behavior: Hovering previews the rating in interactive mode.
accessibility: Interactive mode is a radiogroup; read-only mode is an image with a text label.

segmented-control.summary: WDS segmented control: a single choice in a filled track.

styles.note: Filled track; the selected segment is raised on the elevated color.

items.note: Each segment has a label and optional icon.

size.note: Padding and text follow the Size tokens.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (padding and text).

behavior: Use it to switch a view; use Tabs when it controls panels.
accessibility: A radiogroup of radio buttons; give it an aria-label.

otp-input.summary: WDS one-time code input: one box per character in box or underline style, with error and success states, paste support and auto-advance.

styles.note: Box has a full border; underline only a bottom line.

states.note: Empty / filled follow the value; error and success set the border color.

behavior: Typing moves to the next box; Backspace on an empty box moves back.
Pasting fills all boxes at once.
accessibility: Boxes are grouped; set an aria-label on the group.
The first box hints one-time-code autofill.

pin-input.summary: WDS PIN input: like the OTP input but characters are masked. Defaults to four digits.

styles.note: Same two styles as OTP.

states.note: Follow the value and status.

behavior: Characters are rendered as password fields.
accessibility: Never show the PIN in logs or URLs.

quantity-selector.summary: WDS quantity selector with minus / plus buttons around the value, in outlined, filled or ghost style.

styles.note: Outlined has a border, filled a subtle background, ghost neither.

states.note: A control is disabled at the limit.

props.size: Size from the Size tokens (container height).

behavior: The value is clamped to min / max.
accessibility: Buttons are labelled Decrease / Increase; the value is a live region.

label-text.summary: WDS label text for fields: three weights, a red required mark and an optional trailing icon.

mandatory.note: The red asterisk comes after the optional info icon.

props.htmlFor: Associates the label with a field.

behavior: FormItem already renders this style for its labels.
accessibility: Use htmlFor so clicking the label focuses the field.

compact-select.summary: WDS compact select: a small text or icon trigger that opens a dropdown menu to pick one option.

types.note: Text shows the value and a chevron; icon shows only an icon.

menu.note: Options render as menu items; the current one is selected.

props.icon: Trigger icon for the icon type; disables it.

behavior: Click outside closes the menu.
accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded; give icon triggers an aria-label.

dropdown-menu.summary: WDS dropdown menu: a panel of menu items with icons, supporting text and default, selected, disabled and destructive states.

styles.note: Elevated background with a subtle border and radius 12.

props.items: Menu items: value, label, description, icon, state flags, onSelect.
props.align: Which edge of the trigger the menu aligns to.

behavior: Selecting an item runs its handler and closes the menu.
Click outside or Escape closes it.
accessibility: Uses role="menu" and "menuitem".

list-item.summary: WDS list item: a row with leading element, title, supporting text and trailing accessory; default, pressed, selected and disabled.

states.note: Pressed shows while the item is held down.

props.title: Main and supporting text.
props.leading: Elements before and after the text.

behavior: Without onClick the row is a plain div.
accessibility: Interactive rows expose aria-pressed for selection.

popover.summary: WDS popover: a floating panel with title, text, custom content and actions, opened by clicking its trigger.

styles.note: Elevated background, radius 12, subtle border.

props.content: Extra body; the action buttons share the width equally.
props.placement: Preferred side; clamped to the viewport.

behavior: Click outside or Escape closes it.
Rendered in a portal next to the trigger.
accessibility: The panel has role="dialog"; the trigger exposes aria-expanded.

toast.summary: WDS toast: a dark transient message with a status icon and close button, shown through the useToast hook.

styles.note: Dark background; the icon color follows the variant.

props.container: Where and how wide the toast renders.

behavior: Hides itself after the duration; the close button hides it sooner.
accessibility: Error and warning use role="alert"; others role="status".

section-header.summary: WDS section header: a section title with supporting text, an accessory beside the title, actions and a bottom divider.

styles.note: Surface background with a subtle bottom stroke.

slots.note: Badge next to the title; buttons on the right.

props.title: Title and supporting text.
props.titleAccessory: Badge or icon beside the title.

behavior: Use it at the top of a Card or page section.
accessibility: Renders the title as an h2.

nav-item.summary: WDS nav item: a standalone navigation row in light or dark style with icon, badge and chevron.

styles.note: Dark is used on the brand-pressed side navbar.

states.note: Current uses the brand fill.

props.label: Text and icon.
props.href: Renders an anchor when href is set.

behavior: SideNavbar uses the same dark look for its items.
accessibility: The current item has aria-current="page".

featured-icon.summary: WDS featured icon: an icon inside a colored container, circle or rounded square.

styles.note: Light styles tint the background; dark inverts the icon.

behavior: Used in Dialog and Empty State headers.
accessibility: Decorative; the surrounding text carries the meaning.

icon-wrapper.summary: WDS icon wrapper: gives any icon a fixed size and the primary icon color.
behavior: The icon fills the wrapper.
accessibility: Decorative by default; label the control around it.

image.summary: WDS image / placeholder: a flat gray block with nine preset aspect ratios that shows the image once there is a source. Default or rounded corners.

styles.note: Rounded uses radius 16.

props.ratio: Aspect ratio (Figma Ratio); ignored when height is set.

behavior: Images are cropped to fill the frame.
accessibility: Provide alt text for meaningful images.

image-carousel.summary: WDS image carousel: slides with previous / next buttons and dot indicators where the active dot stretches.

config.note: The active dot follows the slide index.

controls.note: Current dot uses the brand color; others the disabled color.

props.showArrows: Previous / next buttons (Figma shows only the dots).

behavior: Navigation wraps around at both ends.
accessibility: Dots are tabs; arrows have accessible names.

scroll-area.summary: WDS scroll area: a scrollable container with a thin custom scrollbar in default, grey-track or outline style.

styles.note: Grey fills the track; outline adds a track border.

behavior: Uses the native scrollbar styled with CSS; Firefox gets a thin variant.
accessibility: The area is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it.

activity-feed.summary: WDS activity feed: a timeline of actions with avatars, a connector line and content per type (file, labels, text, chat).

types.note: Each type adds its own content block.

styles.note: Connector and file border use the default stroke.

props.items: Entries: name, action, time, avatar, type and content.

behavior: The last entry has no connector.
accessibility: Rendered as an ordered list.

chat-message.summary: WDS chat message bubble: received (with avatar and name) or sent (brand-filled with a read receipt).

types.note: Received is subtle with a sharp top-left corner; sent is brand-filled with a sharp top-right.

meta.note: Receipt only on sent; name only on received.

behavior: Bubble width is capped at 260px.
accessibility: Pair messages with visible timestamps.

chat-input.summary: WDS chat input: a pill message field with an attach button and a send button that enables once there is text.

styles.note: Surface bar with a subtle top border and a subtle field.

props.onSend: Called on submit with non-empty text.

behavior: Enter submits the form; empty text cannot be sent.
accessibility: Attach and send buttons have accessible names.

bar-line-chart.summary: WDS line and bar chart drawn in SVG, with grid lines, axis labels and a legend.

series.note: The first series uses primary-500; the area uses primary-400.

axes.note: The Y axis scales to the largest value.

props.series: Several series with shared X labels; replaces data.
props.stacked: Stacks the bars of several series.

behavior: Scales with its container width.
accessibility: The SVG has role="img" and a label; provide the data in text elsewhere.

pie-chart.summary: WDS pie chart in SVG with a vertical legend; switch to a donut with one prop.

series.note: Slices step down the primary scale.

behavior: Values are converted to percentages of the total.
accessibility: Provide the values in text as well.

radar-chart.summary: WDS radar chart in SVG: radial axes, concentric rings and up to three series.

series.note: Series use primary-500, secondary-500 and warning-500.

behavior: Polygons are semi-transparent so overlaps stay readable.
accessibility: Provide the values in text as well.

activity-gauge.summary: WDS activity gauge: a ring that fills to a percentage, with the value in the centre.

track.note: The track is the lightest primary; the arc is primary-500.

props.rings: Concentric rings, outside to inside; replaces value.
props.label: Centre text (default: percent) and diameter.

behavior: The value is clamped to 0–100.
accessibility: The SVG exposes the percentage as its label.

legend.summary: WDS legend: a color dot and label per series, horizontal or vertical. Used inside the chart components.
behavior: Wraps onto several lines when horizontal.
accessibility: Rendered as a list.

calendar.summary: WDS calendar: the standalone month grid used inside the date picker, with month and year views.

styles.note: Box has a card background; underline is flat.

days.note: Dates outside min / max are disabled.

behavior: Click the header to switch between day, month and year views.
accessibility: Built on react-datepicker, which supports keyboard navigation.

menu-item.summary: WDS menu item: a selectable row with leading and trailing slots and optional supporting text. The same item is used inside DropdownMenu and Select.

states.note: Pressed shows while the item is held down.

slots.note: Icon, avatar, checkbox or radio before; badge, chevron or toggle after.

size.note: Padding and text follow the Size tokens.

props.label: Main and supporting text.
props.slots: Elements before and after the text.

behavior: Inside DropdownMenu the item closes the menu after its handler runs.
accessibility: Use role="menuitem" when placed inside a menu container.

scroll-bar.summary: WDS scroll bar: a position indicator with arrow buttons at both ends and a draggable thumb, vertical or horizontal.

types.note: Track length is set in px.

styles.note: Grey fills the track; outline adds a border.

size.note: Thickness follows the Size tokens.

props.thumbSize: Thumb length (% of track) and track length (px).
props.size: Size from the Size tokens and the arrow step.

behavior: Click or drag the track to move; arrows and arrow keys move by the step prop.
ScrollArea styles the native scrollbar of a container; ScrollBar is the standalone indicator.
accessibility: role="scrollbar" with aria-valuenow; focusable with arrow, Home and End keys.

file-upload-card.summary: WDS file upload card: a file row with progress, status text, retry and delete. FileUpload uses it for the chosen files.

states.note: Error uses the danger fill and shows a retry button.

type.note: Bar sits under the text; fill tints the card background.

props.name: File name and formatted size.
props.actions: Retry (error only), delete and extra actions.

behavior: Progress is data-driven; the component does not upload by itself.
accessibility: The progress bar uses role="progressbar"; buttons have accessible names.

user-cell.summary: WDS user cell: an avatar with name and supporting text, used in table cells and lists.

cell.note: Matches the user cell in the Figma Table.

behavior: Long names truncate with an ellipsis.
accessibility: The avatar is decorative; the name carries the meaning.
